# miku-ms-office-core-java vendor

This directory vendors the `miku-ms-office-core-java` release jar used by
`miku-md2pptx-java` for low-level Office package ZIP/OPC/XML helpers.

- Source repository: <https://github.com/igapyon/miku-ms-office-core-java>
- Release: `v0.6.0`
- File: `miku-ms-office-core-0.6.0.jar`
- SHA-256: `d25392727d9449e5001b9024b888f0ce09962c9fb977c18613731f37027b0a77`

`miku-md2pptx-java` keeps PPTX document assembly, PowerPoint-specific
templates, Markdown conversion semantics, and summary policy in this
repository. The vendored jar owns product-neutral ZIP / OPC package plumbing.
